10/S0.subgoal: Define cybersickness (VIMS) and identify its common symptoms.

10/S1.subgoal: Describe the importance of mitigating cybersickness and explain the role of age in susceptibility.

10/S2.subgoal: Explain the impact of gender and inter-pupillary distance on cybersickness.

10/S3.subgoal: Explain the connection between motion sickness susceptibility and cybersickness.

10/S4.subgoal: Describe how physical and emotional conditions affect cybersickness.

10/S5.subgoal: Describe how hardware factors like display resolution contribute to cybersickness.

10/S6.subgoal: Explain how latency and latency jitter impact the user experience in VR.

10/S7.subgoal: Describe how display types and input methods influence cybersickness and summarize the internal and external causes.
